continuity_scope: ELDEN RING base game, English-language official Bandai Namco product-page release boundary (25 February 2022). The character claims use the original-game product page and official base-game story-trailer transcript only. Shadow of the Erdtree, later patches and patch-specific mechanics, Tarnished Edition, Nightreign, regional/localized texts, and adaptations are excluded continuities.
work_or_witnesses: Bandai Namco Europe: ELDEN RING official product page
Bandai Namco Europe: ELDEN RING – Story Summary Explained (official story-trailer transcript)
Bandai Namco Europe: Shadow of the Erdtree official expansion page
coverage_rule: All stable named non-avatar dramatic individuals directly named and functionally described in the selected official base-game product/trailer witnesses: Queen Marika the Eternal and Melina. The player-created Tarnished is an excluded avatar role. No other NPC, boss, demigod, deity, companion, faction leader, or individual is added without a claim-level official profile or reproducible direct dialogue/item-description locator.
omissions: The player-created Tarnished, all chosen class/build, Great Rune, grace, online interaction, player choices, allies, paths, deaths, and endings.

All named NPCs, bosses, demigods, gods, companions, invaders, merchants, and other dramatic individuals beyond Marika and Melina because the selected official base-game witnesses do not give them individual claim-level profiles or direct in-game dialogue/item-description locators.
Classes, demigods as a category, factions, items, places, runes, grace, mechanics, mounts, enemies, and online systems as character nodes.

Shadow of the Erdtree and its Land of Shadow/Miquella/Messmer content; later patches; Tarnished Edition; Nightreign; adaptations; regional/localized editions; fan/community/wiki sources; guides, walkthroughs, lore videos, data mines, item-description transcription archives, and secondary databases.
uncertainties: The selected official product material is a high-level premise, and the official story-summary page is a trailer transcript. Direct in-game item descriptions and full dialogue/codex locators were not accessible in the reviewed first-party evidence, so detailed lore interpretation is intentionally excluded.

Marika's product-page description is official campaign framing; no unlisted motive, identity theory, family detail, chronology, state, or ending is inferred. Melina's direct trailer lines establish an offer to the avatar only; no universal outcome of that accord is asserted.
The base game is selected at the listed release boundary. Later patches can alter balance, summon-pool behavior, UI, and content support; no patch state is universalized.
Shadow of the Erdtree is a separately sold expansion requiring the base game and adding enemies, bosses, plotlines, equipment, skills, and magic. It is not folded into base-game character evidence.

English wording was reviewed. Japanese and other localized item/dialogue wording may differ, and ambiguous item-description traditions remain unresolved. Branching endings and multiplayer are not represented as fixed canon events.
evidence_basis: First-party Bandai Namco official product, story-trailer transcript, and expansion pages only. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, community source, review, walkthrough, lore video, mod, data mine, or secondary database is used as canonical evidence.
